scope: Native A2A graph node with per-invocation stable-pause checkpoints and response reconciliation; not active-run crash recovery

extendsCapturedCheckpoint.policy: Use the captured card checkpoint, replacing only current files listed in this manifest. Other core shared changes belong to their separate owning scopes.

compatibilityPolicy: Native explicit composition: TypeScript invokable remote text adapter plus Python server structured interrupt protocol and native graph checkpoints. Pinned Python remote client rejects interrupt responses; do not claim upstream durable remote resume was already implemented.
contracts: Borrowed real HTTP/SSE client; typed progress/output and authoritative task lifecycle.
Shared node declarations keep mutable execution/checkpoint data in graph invocation state, without caller InvocationState SDK keys.
Opaque local RemoteAgent questions remain separate from native tool approvals; Agent interrupt ledger rejects that source.
Structured remote ID mapping, text-only visible projection with intact response protocol data, partial answers across fresh file-backed graphs.
Strict bounded checkpoint scope/version/node/task/context/question/source validation before atomic load, backward-compatible absent field.
Hashed discovery/configured/selected endpoint binding; restored discovered changes rejected before continuation; visits use an endpoint-bound client.
Accepted answers save before execution even when retrying existing DeferredResponses after an earlier failed save.
Pure preaccept response validation preserves mixed hook/body batch atomicity; invalid generic JSON can be corrected.
Preflight tasks/get recovers lost completed replies without resending structured answers; active tasks refuse another message.
Observed new pauses remove only proved-consumed deferred answers before progress publication, preserving early-disposal snapshots.
Distinct subsequent generic question IDs; generic text-only responses and explicit authentication-host boundary.
Handled uncertain generic sends refuse automatic paused text replay while allowing observed terminal reconciliation.
Iterator cleanup preserves original failures and attaches diagnostics; clients and remote executions remain borrowed.
